decks.title: Numbers, days and months
decks.description: Numbers 0–100, the days of the week and the months, with "on Monday" and "in July".

decks.title: Family and people
decks.description: Family words, describing people, nationalities and jobs.

decks.title: Food and drink
decks.description: Drinks, meals, everyday food and the phrases you need at the table.

decks.title: Home and town
decks.description: Rooms, furniture and places in town, with w or na.

decks.title: Accusative in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the accusative. A1: singular.

decks.title: Genitive in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the genitive: after nie, nie ma, do, z (from), od, bez, dla, u, dużo, and for "of". A1: singular.

decks.title: Locative in sentences
decks.description: Put the place in brackets into the locative after w or na. A1: singular.

decks.title: Instrumental in sentences
decks.description: Put the phrase in brackets into the instrumental: a job or nationality after być, z meaning "with", and "by bus", "by card". A1: singular.

decks.title: Core verbs
decks.description: The most common verbs: type the infinitive, then use it in the present. A1 part: 60 of 100 cards; A2 adds the rest. The cards ask for the everyday (imperfective) verb; its partner for a finished action is also accepted.
